gates.requiredScope: The reviewed pull-request head executes restore, Release build, the complete test solution, and DocFX on Linux.
gates.rationale: Linux is a supported runtime and documentation platform.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: The CI command body, supported runtime matrix, solution, or documentation build changes.

gates.requiredScope: The reviewed pull-request head executes restore, Release build, the complete test solution, and DocFX on macOS.
gates.rationale: macOS is a supported runtime and the local development platform.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: The CI command body, supported runtime matrix, solution, or documentation build changes.

gates.requiredScope: The reviewed pull-request head executes restore, Release build, the complete test solution, and DocFX on Windows, including keyboard, path, and terminal-fallback tests.
gates.rationale: A tooling-only Windows job cannot prove the accepted runtime boundary.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: The Windows runner, CI command body, keyboard adapter, path behavior, or terminal fallback changes.

gates.requiredScope: The reviewed pull-request head builds DocFX and executes the Playwright and Axe documentation smoke path.
gates.rationale: Feature 028 changes learner-facing status and evidence documentation.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: DocFX configuration, navigation, generated API, A11Y tests, or user-facing documentation changes.

gates.requiredScope: Repository secret scanning and Lastenheft rename-contract tests execute on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows for the reviewed head.
gates.rationale: The feature archives three Lastenhefte and changes maintained agent guidance.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Rename rules, secret scanner behavior, agent paths, or supported repository platforms change.

gates.requiredScope: The reviewed pull-request head completes vulnerable and deprecated package review plus temporary CycloneDX validation.
gates.rationale: Existing supply-chain validation remains a required repository gate even though the feature adds no dependency.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Dependencies, lock files, package tooling, distribution, or SBOM policy changes.

gates.requiredScope: The reviewed pull-request head passes the agent-surface secret scan.
gates.rationale: Maintained agent guidance and evidence files change in this feature, so the repository-owned agent scanner remains independently reviewable.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Agent surfaces, agent-secret rules, scanner commands, or tracked credential boundaries change.

gates.requiredScope: The reviewed pull-request head passes the repository Gitleaks review.
gates.rationale: Gitleaks is a separate required workflow run and must not be represented as part of the agent-secret scanner's Primary evidence.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: The Gitleaks workflow, action, secret rules, or tracked credential boundaries change.

gates.requiredScope: A dedicated WSL runtime command is not available in the repository workflow; Windows proof is not relabeled as WSL proof.
gates.rationale: No managed WSL runner or accepted WSL command exists for this repository at planning time.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: A WSL runner, workflow job, or reproducible WSL acceptance command becomes available.
